parts.text: {"finding_id":"FINDING-PILOT-01","verdict":"FAIL","identified_issues":["Conflation of proxy observation status with underlying physical system state","Premature state transition in database prior to storage commit acknowledgement","Absence of storage artifact verification before marking workflow step as SUCCESS and triggering billing","Silent storage backend crash resulting in unhandled disk exhaustion failure"],"evidence":["The orchestrator marked task_991 as SUCCESS and generated a completion invoice based on an HTTP 200 response with task_status READY.","Independent inspection of storage cluster telemetry revealed no file named archive.zip exists for task_991 in the storage bucket.","Storage backend worker crashed due to disk exhaustion at block 4,096 while writing the archive.","Status API returned a static template based on a premature database state transition executed prior to storage commit acknowledgement."],"recommended_action":"Modify the task completion lifecycle to require a verified two-phase commit or explicit storage write acknowledgement before transitioning task status to READY in the database. Implement a HEAD check or cryptographic checksum verification against the storage bucket prior to returning download URLs and triggering downstream billing workflows. Add disk capacity monitoring and crash recovery alerts for the storage backend.","confidence":"HIGH"}
